layout: Four columns of orientations; desktop idle, desktop typing, laptop idle, laptop typing rows.

variants.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: attached transparent 4x4 workstation sprite atlas. Preserve exact square canvas, equal 4 columns x 4 rows, workstation positions, relative size, pixel-art linework, wooden desks, chairs, computers, alpha transparency and generous gutters. Columns retain reference orientations. Rows 1 and 2 are desktop idle/typing, rows 3 and 4 are laptop idle/typing. Change ONLY the employee in ALL SIXTEEN cells to the SAME new character described below. Match same identity, hair, clothing and headgear between devices and corresponding idle/typing rows; only fingers and tiny screen lights change between animation rows. No grid lines, labels, cropped edges or empty cells. Character: adult man with medium-brown skin, slicked-back black hair, burgundy waistcoat over rolled-sleeve ivory shirt, narrow black tie, dark trousers, black headset with boom microphone. Distinct smart con-artist silhouette; tiny gold wristwatch.
